text:
Mia: Nexus (appliance partner) wants private offers + SI co-sell credits. Need pricing bands, caps, renewal mechanics, and announcement plan.

Carlos: I'll draft bands. Propose 4 micro-bands so field can price more granularly.

Lina: Ops: require separate SKUs per deployment (hosted/dedicated/private). Need SKU CSV and mapping.

Devon: Sales: define "co-sell activity" and per-deal cap. Also want early-convert credit if pilot converts quickly.

Priya: Legal: credits must expire and be non-transferable. Also add export-control clause for on-prem hardware installs.

Carlos: Draft bands (rough):
Band A - $6k/yr -> 5% + $5k onboarding credit, 6mo term
Band B - $50k/yr -> 12% + $12k onboarding credit, 12mo term
Band C - $250k/yr -> 18% + $25k onboarding credit, 12mo term
Band D - $300k+/yr -> 28% + $50k onboarding credit + prioritized support, 12/24 option

Devon: Renewal incentive: increase commit >=20% -> extra 3% next-term discount. Early-convert: pilot->paid within 45 days = $3k extra credit.

Priya: Legal ok with early-convert but limited to first-time customers. Will draft PO snippets: credit expiry 6 months, non-transferable, not redeemable for cash. Add approval requirement for co-branded content.

Lina: Band D prioritized support requires Dedicated capacity mapping. Ops will confirm infra and add 2 days for listing QA.

Carlos: Add soft cap $40k per account and per-deal cap max 30% of committed value. Approvals required if credits > $25k per deal.

partner-bot: Nexus requested 72-hr pre-notification for public comms. Link: https://nexus.example/comms-draft

Mia: Mutual review window: 48 business hours for joint announcements. No unilateral publishes.

Devon: Case study at 90 days to unlock $10k marketing fund; require usage >50% of committed and customer quote.

Mia: Action items: Carlos -> finance model + caps; Priya -> PO clauses + export flag; Lina -> SKU CSV + infra check; Devon -> enablement + case study metrics. Lock numbers by Thursday so Marketplace can list Friday.

Carlos: Will post updated bands Wed afternoon.

partner-bot: Reminder set: follow-up Thursday 09:00 PT.
